map.根据复发性阿弗他溃疡(RAS)的大小、数量、病程与愈合特征，进行分型与病期判断。: Classifies recurrent aphthous stomatitis (RAS) by size, number, course and healing features into types and stages.

map.单个溃疡最大直径 (mm): Largest diameter of a single ulcer (mm)
map.⚠️ 超过2-3周不愈的溃疡需活检排除恶性病变。伴全身症状的溃疡应排查白塞病、炎: Ulcers lasting over 2-3 weeks need biopsy to exclude malignancy. Ulcers with systemic symptoms should check for Behcet's disease, IBD and other systemic diseases.
map.• 多见于唇、颊、舌非角化黏膜: Mostly on lip, cheek, tongue non-keratinized mucosa
map.• 数周至数月愈合，常留瘢痕: Heals in weeks to months, often scars
map.• 多见于软腭、咽部、颊后部: Mostly on soft palate, pharynx, posterior cheek
map.• 溃疡期：早期(2-4天)→活动期(5-10天): Ulcer stage: early (2-4 days) -> active (5-10 days)
map.• 愈合期：上皮覆盖，红斑消退: Healing stage: epithelial coverage, erythema fades
map.轻型溃疡直径 <5mm、7~10 天自愈，工具判定为轻型 RAS 并提示自限。: Minor ulcers <5mm that self-heal in 7-10 days are classified as minor RAS with a self-limiting note.
map.大型深在溃疡 >10mm、病程数周，提示重型（腺周口疮）需就诊。: Large deep ulcers >10mm with a course of weeks suggest major (periadenitis) and need medical attention.
map.复发频繁者量化年发作次数，提示系统排查诱因。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初筛参考: Frequent recurrences quantify annual episodes, prompting systemic trigger screening. (Results are for oral-health education and self-screening only, not a substitute for oral examination, periapical film/CBCT imaging, or diagnosis and treatment by dental, orthodontic or periodontal specialists; if you have toothache, gum bleeding, non-healing ulcers, abnormal oral mucosa or occlusal discomfort, please visit a regular hospital dental department promptly.)
map.输入：溃疡直径 3mm，数量 2 个，病程 8 天，年复发 4 次\n判定：轻型:
Input: ulcer diameter 3mm, count 2, course 8 days, annual recurrence 4 times
Determination: minor recurrent aphthous ulcer, self-limiting; if diameter >10mm or course >3 weeks, suggest medical attention.
map.轻型（最常见，<5mm 自愈）、重型（腺周口疮，深大、瘢痕）、疱疹样（多发小溃疡: Minor (most common, <5mm self-healing), major (periadenitis, deep/large, scarring), herpetiform (multiple small clustered ulcers); distinguished by size and course.
map.与遗传、免疫、压力、创伤、营养（铁/B 族）及消化因素有关；频繁或重型建议排查全: Related to genetics, immunity, stress, trauma, nutrition (iron/B vitamins) and digestion; frequent or major types suggest checking systemic factors.
map.什么情况要就医？: When should I see a doctor?
map.溃疡 >2 周不愈、直径 >10mm、伴发热或皮疹、或有白红斑病变，应尽早到口腔: Ulcer unhealed >2 weeks, diameter >10mm, with fever or rash, or white/red lesions should be seen at an oral-mucosa clinic early to exclude malignancy.
map.关于「口腔溃疡阿弗它分期器」: About the Oral Ulcer Aphthous Staging Tool
map.口腔溃疡阿弗它分期器 - 根据溃疡大小数量病程特征分型分期，区分轻型重型疱疹样阿: Oral Ulcer Aphthous Staging Tool - Types and stages ulcers by size, number and course features, distinguishing minor, major and herpetiform aphthous ulcers. A professional medical tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
map.口腔溃疡双轨判定：分型按 直径/数量/愈合时间/瘢痕——直径 ≤5mm 且 1~: Dual-track oral ulcer assessment: type by diameter/count/healing time/scar — diameter ≤ 5 mm with 1~5 lesions and no scar → minor MiRAS; diameter ≥ 10 mm or healing > 14 days or a scar or the deep-large box checked → major MaRAS; count 6~10 or > 10 and clustered or diameter ≤ 2 mm → herpetiform HU; otherwise an intermediate type pending assessment. Disease stage maps the duration dropdown to prodromal/early/active/healing. Validation: a non-numeric or ≤ 0 diameter reports "Please enter a valid ulcer diameter". Criteria: non-recurrent large ulcers suggest biopsy, slow healing or scarring calls for screening for systemic disease, and accompanying fever calls for screening for viral infection.
